EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Noeliel the Ice Statue!!
RAIDBOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Noeliel the Ice Statue!!
The current difficulty is different from the one\nwhen you used [Sacred Snow]. The difficulty will\nchange to the one when you used [Sacred Snow].
Pom?! *hiss*
Something was really there...
What's wrong?
Strange shadow? We didn't see anything.\nIt's a sacred place so evil existence can't enter\nhere. That should be your imagination.
Hey! Heeey!!\nStop! Stooooop!!
Oh, it's you! You came again!!\nI'm sorry... I haven't collected much Sacred Snow.\nIt takes me too long...
What? You help me out?!\nThank you!!
Hey, monsters! Play time is over!\nThis adventurer will get Sacred Snow from you!!
This is the main room to amplify Xmas energy...
But how...?
How to amplify the energy?
Oh, right. You came from another world.\nLet me explain about it...
We create the ice statue of Noeliel the great\nspirit and put it on this podium to gather energy\nin Navida and amplify with the statue...
Noeliel is the greatest spirit and she is the\ncreator of the spirit you met before.\nWe make her statue with Sacred Snow.
But we have to hunt monsters in the castle to get\nthe Sacred Snow and we need a lot to make the\nstatue.
The knights have left for other worlds, so\nNicola and I have to collect the snow.\nBut we are not sure we can make it...
It would be difficult for me to deal with monsters\nand collect the snow. We can't make it for Xmas...
So, please hurry!
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
Whoa! Finished already?!
Feel like it's too fast... Whoa, there it is!\nThis should be enough for making the statue!\nI know you're skilled but it's still amazing...
Awesome! You're great!
Sir, let's make the ice statue now!
Alright!\nI won't waste the Sacred Snow you collected for us!
Yes... Yes! We made it!!
We did it. We made it for Xmas.\nNow we can amplify Xmas energy and deliver to\nother worlds...
What the?!
What's happening?!
Ice Statue of the great spirit, huh...\nSuited for my body!\nYou've done a great job...
Anti-Xmas energy?!\nIt gathered in the sacred ice statue?!
!! Why?!
Anti-Xmas energy exists as long as Xmas energy\ndoes... Both energies conflict with one another.\nHowever, one can absorb the other!!
Shut up!
Leader no!\nWe can't amplify the energy if we break it!\nWe won't make it for Xmas!
Kick out the Anti Xmas energy from the statue?!\nB-But how...
We have no options...\nI need backup!
It's been a while since I last came here...\nBut I don't see any changes.
Yeah.\nThere's nothing strange here.
Just what was that mysterious presence we sensed\nearlier?
Oh my gosh?!\nW-what is this?!
Dang...! Who the hey are you?!
Lemme just tell you my name.\nI'm Dutannen, the ruler of this castle!
That's nonsense! This is Noeliel's castle!
For now yeah, but soon this place will turn into\nDark Noeliel Castle.
Nicola! I'll leave Ms. Velly to you!
I need your help too!
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
The energy of Xmas in the castle!\nGather in the statue!!
Gugyaaaaaaa!!
Um, maybe there's still not enough energy.\nOr could it be that your power is greater than my\nexpectation?
Ugh, I don't believe there's nothing I can do to\nstop you...
...I see.\nSomeone with a considerable amount of Xmas energy\nis here. Perfect!
W-what is this...?!
Ms. Velly?!\nUgh...this is...
Ugh, just what was that...\nMs. Velly! Mr. Dunder, Nicola, is everyone okay?!
Umm...\nOh, Sir Agios! Are you okay?!
I'm fine.\nI'm more worried about Ms. Velly. how is she?
Wait, what's going on here..?\nThere's almost no Xmas energy left in Ms. Velly's\nbody.
Perhaps that Dutannen thing stole it and used it\nas anti-Xmas energy.\nAnyway, we should get her someplace to rest...!
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
Hey, it's you! You came again?\nI'm happy to see you here.
Nicola?\nShe's collecting the Sacred Snow in the castle.
The ice statue got scratches and cracks because of\nthe incident.
Xmas energy may flow out from them and get weaker.\nWe need to restore it to prevent negative effects\nin another world.
But she's late... The knights are away, so\nI asked her to collect but...\nSeems like it's too much for her...
What? You can go help her out?
Hmm... She might be having a hard time collecting\nthe snow but...
Well, I need your help.\nI must stay alert and watch for the ice statue...
Thanks.
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
Whoa! Finished already?!\nYou're incredibly skilled at hunting monsters.
Heh! I know I'm a useless apprentice knight!
Nicola, what are you doing?\nWe can't waste the Sacred Snow.\nWe've gotta get down to the business!
Yea! We made it!!
Xmas energy won't get weaker from now.\nAnd there will be no bad effects in other worlds.
I appreciate your help...
Whoa! Anti Xmas energy again?!
No, it's not! I don't feel any evil power like\nlast time... It's rather divine...!!\nIt must be...!
The knights of Navida.\nI've seen that you are sending Xmas energy\nto other worlds on behalf of me...
On behalf of you...?
I knew it!\nNoeliel the Great Spirit!!
Whaaat?!
Not only restoring Navida City, you helped them\nsend Xmas energy this time. The adventurer from\nanother world. I appreciate your help.
Thanks to you and the knights of Navida,\nI was able to show myself here again...
I couldn't be any happier if our efforts have\nhelped you to descend...
Glad to hear that. May I ask you one more favor?\nI'd like you to fight the ice statue.
I'm afraid I don't understand what you are saying.\nMay I ask why we have to fight you?
A small amount of anti Xmas energy is still\nin the ice statue.\nIt might go on a rampage later...
I'll push out the anti Xmas energy inside of\nthe statue to the surface while you're fighting.\nSo, I want you to strike it including the ice.
I understood.\nIf you say it works...
Nicola, are you ready?
Yea! I'll do my best for the knights who are out\nto the other worlds too!!
CHRISTMAS EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Dutannen!!
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
Noeliel, are you alright?
Well done. It should be alright now.\nFor now, I don't see any remnant of anti Xmas\nenergy in the ice statue...
Awesome!
Without your help, I wouldn't have finished\nrestoring the ice statue and seen the great\nspirit. Thank you so much.
If the great spirit didn't descend, we wouldn't\nhave noticed the remnant of anti Xmas energy and\nlet it revive...
I'll tell the knights about what happened today!\nI'm sure I did a great job! Heh heh...
Oh, and I've got some rewards for you.
Leader, please.
Yea.
It might not be enough for you but...
Thank you so much! See you again!!
I'm looking forward to seeing you again.\nTake care.
You unlocked and opened the box!
The box is already open...
H-how is it Mr. Dunder?\nIs Ms. Velly okay?
She won't be able to move for a while.\nWe must retrieve the power that Dutannen stole...\nBut it feels strange.
What do you mean? What's strange?
He said he wanted to turn this place into the\nDark Noeliel Castle. Perhaps that's also why he\nstole Lady Velly's power.
But at least I don't see anything unusual\nhappening on this floor. Or maybe it's just not\nhappening yet...
Yeah, I'm curious about it too.\nLet's go back downstairs and check it out!
I see. Well, I'll wait here then.
You're not coming with us?
We might find some treasure tho?
Um...why would I risk my life crossing that\ndangerous bridge for nothing? Besides, I feel bad\nabout abandoning a sick person here.
S-shut up!\nBesides, Velly is not a stranger to me.\nI can't just abandon her!
She's right. It's not a good idea to leave\nLady Velly here alone since she can't move.\nMaybe it's better if we let Ms. Pelulu stay.
In that case, I'll go with you, Sir!
No, I want you to continue keeping Ms. Velly safe.\nMr. Dunder too, I want you to stay close to\nMs. Velly.
Hopefully we can retrieve the power from Dutannen,\nbut should something go wrong, I need you to\nevacuate them to Navida City.
Understood! Be careful, sir...
I can't fight, but I'll pray from here that you\nwill restore Lady Velly's power!
How many [Sacred Snow] do you want to give him?
Quit
You don't have enough [[ffff64]Sacred Snow[ffffff]]...
Did you know that Navida is in the world called\nEstagia? ...Oh. So, Nicola told you about it.
There are several towns in Estagia and each\nof them has the duty to watch and keep seasonal\nfestival safe.
There's always negative power like anti Xmas\nenergy in the places where festivals are held.\nSo, we prevent it from increasing.
